multiplier_clarification.defined_as: multiplicative factor applied to each task’s measured sum of server-call wall duration; task-level outside gaps remain unchanged.
multiplier_clarification.prior_0_8_0_6_0_45: These shorten measured service durations by 20%, 40%, and 55% respectively; they imply nominal service-throughput increases of 1.25x, 1.67x, and 2.22x under an inverse-duration interpretation. They were hypothetical faster scenarios, not P19-measured results.
multiplier_clarification.new_scenarios: 1.0 preserves measured call duration; 1.5 and 2.0 model respectively 50% and 100% longer service durations (nominal inverse-duration factors 0.667x and 0.5x).
multiplier_clarification.rate_caveat: The P19 AR B1 acceptance rate 18.505836 tokens/s and selected-policy vLLM B1 rate 34.770637 tokens/s are different serving/measurement regimes. Neither their ratio nor either rate calibrates per-call times in this 4,427-call ledger. The ledger also lacks per-request prefill/decode decomposition and concurrency-specific B8 service rates.

deadline_feasibility_as_of.comparison: All 7- and 8-agent scenarios exceed the remaining execution allowance before fixed HF/closure/validation reserves. Even the observed-duration 8-agent replay requires 4.95h vs about 2.84h available for the candidate. Scenarios are historical sensitivity only; this does not predict actual P19 B8 wall time or imply admission.

limitations: Same frozen task order and indivisible task-level queues as prior simulation; outside gaps are held at observed durations.
No modeling of changed output lengths, request mix, prefill/decode composition, batching, or context-dependent service rates.
Do not use AR/vLLM rate ratios to scale the historical call ledger.
Any actual candidate run requires a fresh forecast from its matched B8 measured per-call rows and a fresh deadline/owner check.

p19_ar_acceptance.scope: B1 full-model autoregressive acceptance measurement; not vLLM serving rate

selected_policy_vllm.scope: 4096 input, 128 output, B1/C1 vLLM serving headline; not the P19 B8 SWE workload

p19_candidate_readiness_snapshot.blocker: Root reports the P19 prefill-resume gate failed 10/14 cases; no selection, serving launch, B8 memory probe, or P19 rate measurement is authorized until diagnosis and acceptance/resume disposition.
p19_candidate_readiness_snapshot.note: This is the referenced forecast/admission snapshot; no SWE admission or P19 B8 rate measurement is asserted by this scenario file.
